***Installation***  
**Step 0: What you need**  
•  HoloLens 2 with internet access  
•  A Windows PC with a USB-C cable  
•  The app package, unzipped on your PC

**Step 1: Prepare the package**  
•  The folder should contain the app installer (the ‘brown box’ icon) and related files  
*(Depending on the device, the icon may not appear as a brown box, but just select the file with the extension ‘**.appx’**)*  
   ![A black screen with textAI-generated content may be incorrect.][image1]

**Step 2: Copy files to the device**  
•  Connect HoloLens 2 to the PC via USB-C.  
   ![][image2]  
•  On your PC, open File Explorer and find ‘HOLOLENS’ in the left sidebar. (with the HoloLens turned on)  
•  Drag and drop the unzipped ‘app package’ folder into the ‘Downloads’ folder.  
  **![A red square with a black backgroundAI-generated content may be incorrect.][image3]**

 **Step 3: Enable Developer Mode (if not already enabled)**  
•  On HoloLens 2: Settings \-\> Update & Security \-\> For developers \-\> turn on Developer Mode.

**Step 4: Install on the device**  
•  On HoloLens 2: open All apps \-\> File Explorer.  
![][image4]

- The File Explorer defaults to ‘Recent files’. Switch to ‘This Device’ to find your app package.

•  Navigate to the Downloads \-\> app package folder(‘InterFACE\_AR\_1.1.0.0\_ARM64\_Test’) you copied.  
•  Open the folder and select the installer (the ‘brown box’ icon).  
•  If prompted, enter the device passcode, then tap Install (bottom right).  
•  Wait for installation to complete. The app appears in All apps, and the application may start right away

**Step 5: Launch and clean up**  
•  Find and launch ‘InterFACE\_AR’ from All apps.  
•  To remove old builds, press and hold an old app’s icon and select Remove/Delete.

***User Guide***

1. **Starting the app**

•  Launch ‘InterFACE\_AR’ from All apps.

•  Select your role:![A blue square shaped platesAI-generated content may be incorrect.][image5]  
 

2. **Handmenu (Visible next to your wrist)**  
     
   

![][image6]  ***![][image7](Handmenu in Doctor role)![][image8] (Handmenu in Doctor role)***

                         
![A blue square with a white pencil][image9]   
•  **PenMode(\<\> Thumbs-up)**: Toggle object manipulation. Use it to move/rotate/resize virtual windows. Toggle it again to show Thumbs-up icon; after that, the windows are locked in place.

![][image10]  
•  **Sessions**: Show/hide the session list

![][image11](It only appears in the Doctor-role)   
•  **Maximize Medication**: Show the medication panel  
•  **Minimize Medication**: Hide the medication panel

![][image12]![][image13]  
•  **Save Position(Pin Icon)**: Save the current layout (window positions/rotations/scales) for reuse.  
•  **Load Position(Star Icon)**: Restore your most recently saved layout.  
•  **Reset Position(Arrow Icon)**: Return all windows to the default layout.

3. **Working with holograms**

![A blue sign with white text][image14]  
•  Refresh Live Sessions and select the currently active session.  
•  In Pen Mode, arrange the virtual windows as needed  
![A screenshot of a computer][image15]

- To move virtual windows, grab the bottom bar and drag it  
- To rotate or resize windows, Tap or click the bottom bar to toggle the manipulation handles. When the handles are visible, use them to rotate or resize the windows; tap again to hide the handle.

•  Saving layout: After arranging windows, tap Save Position to persist your layout; use Load Position to restore it later.  
•  Resetting layout: Tap Reset Position to restore the default arrangement at any time.
